name: SlideMotion
author: Triveni Global Software

sections.description:
SlideMotion is an Elementor widget that enables users to build responsive sliders directly inside the Elementor editor.

The widget supports slides containing images, icons, titles, and text content. Users can control layout, alignment, spacing, and responsive behavior without writing code.

SlideMotion provides slider configuration options suitable for displaying services, features, testimonials, or promotional content within page layouts.

Features

  • Image and icon slides
  • Multiple layout positions (top, left, right)
  • Responsive slides per device
  • Center mode and padding control
  • Variable width slides
  • Vertical slider option
  • Fade transition effect
  • Adaptive height
  • Autoplay with speed control
  • Navigation arrows and dots
  • Draggable slides
  • Pause on hover
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
  3. Open Elementor editor
  4. Search for SlideMotion widget
  5. Drag it into your layout and configure slide settings
